header.name: Urban Space and Gender
header.description: Urban spaces have been consistently growing in India. However, the experience of urban spaces is not linear and homogenous. There is a need to study how the experience of urban spaces is fractured. This course is aimed at developing a deeper understanding of theories, concepts, ideas and issues pertaining to gendered geography of urban spaces. The course focusses on cultivating a better understanding of the gendered experience of urban geography, urban belongingness and urban mobility.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: To exaplain theories and ideas related to gendered geography

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: To identify the issues pertaining to a gendered experience of urban spaces.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: To apply the understanding of gendered geography to space and flows of urban areas

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: To analyse the fractured experience of gender in urban areas.
